name: blip
description: A little blip on your radar when your agent needs you: see what your Copilot CLI agents are doing, live in the macOS menu bar, and approve permission requests right from there.
postInstallMessage: Start a new Copilot session: on first launch the Blip extension builds the macOS app once (about 1–2 minutes, in the background) and starts it. After that your sessions show up in the menu bar.
